SubscribeSign inProspectusWhat is OpenAI Startup Fund?

And who are they funding?

Michael SpencerNov 18, 2022∙ Paid9Share

Hey Guys, 

I think a lot about artificial intelligence at the intersection of venture capital. When GPT-4 is announced, likely in the next three months, OpenAI will again come to the fore. 

In fact, in collaboration with Microsoft, Open AI even has its own fund. The OpenAI Startup Fund looks to invest in AI companies that have a profound impact on the world and can integrate the technology in useful ways in fields like healthcare, education and creativity. 

Sam Altman knows a thing or two about startups and how they can scale. It’s a bit scary to see how much influence he is having in A.I. at this point and will have in the 2020s.
